text:
ben: Heads-up — nightly CI started failing after landing flashattn-v2 optimizations. Not a hard compile crash but we're seeing a perf regression in paged-attention profiles. Can't repro locally yet.

dev-bot: CI failed: //runtime:kernels (linux/gcc-11) — exit code 1 :warning:

amy: Can you paste the failing link and a minimal repro? Also which container image used? :eyes:

ben: https://ci.internal/12345

ben: Error snippet:
```
/usr/bin/ld: undefined reference to `flash_attn::fused_forward_v2'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

zoe: That looks like a symbol mismatch — maybe different compile flags or an LTO setting. Could be visibility or name-mangling.

miguel: We also saw a perf regression in canary traces: KV-cache eviction rate spiked after kernel swap. Batching heuristics started producing more short microbatches which fragments the KV cache.

ben: Quick profiler dump from canary (summary):
```
CPU: 72%  flash_attn_kernel::run
CPU: 15%  kv_cache::apply_updates
CPU:  8%  scheduler::pack_batches
```

amy: Repro steps I'm trying:
```
docker run --rm -it redwood/build:ubuntu22-gcc12 \
  bazel build --config=release //runtime:flash_kernels
```
If local docker uses gcc12 and CI image is gcc11 that could explain the linking + perf deltas.

zoe: Yep — mixing gcc toolchains can change inlining/vectorization and break symbols if we rely on unnamed internal linkage. Also check -fvisibility flags.

miguel: Short mitigation plan: 1) add gcc12 to runtime CI matrix, 2) add microbench job for paged vs fused for seq_len 512/1024, 3) adjust batching heuristic to bias towards longer prefixes for chat to reduce KV churn, 4) kernel selection fallback to classic-attn on symbol/ABI mismatch.

ben: I'll open a PR with a unit test that simulates KV churn and a small perf harness. @miguel @amy any objections?

amy: Go for it. Also add a CI job that builds kernels with both gcc11 and gcc12 images so we catch packaging/linkage mismatches early. :+1:

ci-bot: Created issue #412: "CI: add gcc12 image to runtime kernel matrix" — assigned to eng-runtime.

zoe: And please add a short checklist in the PR description: reproduce steps, which container, flamegraph snapshot, and expected perf numbers. Makes triage much faster.

ben: Will do. Thanks all. :clap:
